_doc: Repos that pin the omniui package. Read by .github/workflows/downstream-pin-bump.yml via scripts/pin-bump-npm.mjs. Mirrors omnibase_core/docs/downstream-repos.yaml (OMN-9050) in shape with two divergences, both deliberate: (1) omnibase_core pins by GIT SHA rewritten with a regex over workflow files; omniui pins by EXACT NPM VERSION in package.json, so the bump edits a dependency entry and then regenerates the lockfile — rewriting package.json without regenerating the lockfile yields a pin that says one thing and installs another, which is worse than not bumping. (2) JSON, not YAML: this is a Node repo with no Python and no YAML parser, and adding either to a public component library so one CI script can read a manifest is a dependency bought for nothing.
_registration_rule: When a repo starts consuming omniui, ADD it here. The bot reads this manifest and never discovers consumers. That is deliberate: discovery is how a consumer gets silently dropped, which is Stall 1's failure mode wearing a different hat.

repos.name: omnidash
repos.notes: Pre-declared, INACTIVE. Phase 1A makes ZERO commits to omnidash (gate G1A.6), and a consumer is registered only when it actually takes the dependency — Phase 2. Registering it before then would reproduce Stall 2 exactly: a pipeline guarding a surface nothing uses. The empty pin_sites list keeps it out of the bump matrix. Landing verb verified 2026-08-24: `gh pr merge --squash --auto`, no merge queue on dev.
